summary: UBS AG filed a Form 6-K providing an opinion of Swiss counsel Homburger AG regarding the validity of debt securities and warrants to be issued under existing indentures. The filing is a routine legal exhibit incorporated into an existing shelf registration statement on Form F-3. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is described. The filing relates solely to ordinary capital markets activities and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
